```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

NHPD_df <- read_excel("data/NHPD Properties Only Export.xlsx")

# significant number of these units don't have construction start or end dates :( 
# HUD sec. 504 passed in 1973
#Note: target tenant type has some "elderly or disabled, disabled" -- does this mean all units (or more than 5% of units would be accessible??)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

date_earliest_const_start <- as.Date(NHPD_df$`Earliest Construction Date`)

NHPD_since_1973 <- NHPD_df %>%
  #make target columns part of Date class
  mutate(
    `Earliest Construction Date` = as.Date(`Earliest Construction Date`),
    `Latest Construction Date` = as.Date(`Latest Construction Date`)
  ) %>%
  # keep only listings from after 1973
  # if earliest year == latest year AND year > 1973,  else if latest const. year > 1973
  filter((
    year(`Earliest Construction Date`) == year(`Latest Construction Date`) &
      year(`Earliest Construction Date`) > 1973
  ) |
    year(`Latest Construction Date`) > 1973) %>%
  # developments with more than 5 units
  filter(`Total Units` > 5)


total_units <- sum(NHPD_since_1973$`Total Units`)
units_accessible <- total_units * .05
units_accessible
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
#intersect size 86
#compare NHPD and KHC development addresses 

KHC <- read_excel("data/KHC Project Listings by Unit Category.xlsx")
NHPD <- read_excel("data/NHPD Properties Only Export.xlsx")

KHC$address_new <- KHC$Address %>%
  #remove zip
  str_replace("\\s\\d{5}$", "") %>%
  str_replace("Louisville", "") %>%
  str_replace("Jeffersontown", "") %>%
  str_to_lower() %>%
  str_replace_all("\\b(north|south|east|west|e|w|n|s)\\b\\.?", "") %>%
  str_replace_all("\\b(lane|hwy|way|road|avenue|ave|ct|pacel|court|street|dr|drive|circle|blvd|rd|ln|st|plaza|parkway)\\b\\.?", "") %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  str_trim()

NHPD$address_new <- NHPD$`Property Address` %>%
  str_to_lower() %>%
  str_replace_all("\\b[ewns]\\b", "") %>%
  str_replace_all("\\b(ln|hwy|way|ave|pl|ct|rd|st|cir|dr|plz|pkwy)\\b", "") %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  str_trim()

NHPD_addresses <- unique(NHPD$address_new)
KHC_addresses <- unique(KHC$address_new)

khc_not_in_nhpd <- setdiff(KHC_addresses, NHPD_addresses)
khc_in_nhpd <- intersect(KHC_addresses, NHPD_addresses) 

head(khc_not_in_nhpd)

# #"1405 broadway"
# "1162 hopeful" and "1164 hopeful"
# "3421 illinois" and "3434 illinois" 
# "4516, 4518, 4524, 4526, 4528 cane run" vs "4517 cane run rd"
# "lambourne blvd" vs "9643 lamborne blvd" 
# "muhammad ali blvd" 
# "greenwood & beech aves" vs "greenwood, hale & kentucky"

```

```{r}
#compare by property name 
#intersect size 135

KHC$property_name_new <- KHC$`Development Name` %>%
  str_to_lower() %>%
  str_trim

NHPD$propert_name_new <- NHPD$`Property Name` %>%
  str_to_lower() %>%
  str_trim()

NHPD_properties <- unique(NHPD$propert_name_new)
KHC_properties <- unique(KHC$property_name_new)

khc_p_not_in_nhpd <- setdiff(KHC_properties, NHPD_properties)
khc_p_in_nhpd <- intersect(KHC_properties, NHPD_properties)
```
